shot1: Shot 1 opens with a wide overhead view, fading in from black. The composition centers the museum’s exterior plaza, with architectural lines and paving forming strong leading lines. Foreground features slowly passing visitors; background shows the faintly visible lobby through glass doors. Focus is on the flow of people converging toward the entrance. The main speaker among the five young women and other attendees appear dispersed in the crowd, moving toward the entrance. Their actions depict an arrival process transitioning from scattered to gathered. The camera performs a minimal downward tilt and forward dolly, establishing spatial scale and formal atmosphere.

The camera follows the main speaker through the lobby past exhibition signage toward the meeting hall entrance. Blurred passersby occasionally cross the foreground; background shows the museum’s high-ceilinged lobby and directional signs. Medium depth of field keeps focus firmly on her face and stride. Indoor ceiling light and side natural light define her silhouette. She carries a folder, walks steadily, with her hem and hair gently swaying. Her action transitions from walking to pushing open the door and entering. The camera smoothly follows her movement with a slight push-in, drawing viewers into the meeting space.

Soft ceiling light evenly illuminates the table and faces. The overall mood remains low-saturation, calm, and professional. The camera slowly orbits the table, laying the spatial foundation for future over-the-shoulder cuts and speaker attribution.
